'''Rels Pero''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a brother, [[Coson Pero]]. At some point, they helped the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Sona Fey'lya]] to take back the ''[[Blue Flare]]'', her [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], to [[Logron]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire" />
